free_tier_limits: Free after registration; subject to AirNow Data Exchange Guidelines. Public docs do not state a non-commercial-only restriction or separate commercial agreement.
resolution_notes: Auditor correct on pricing.free_tier_limits. Official FAQ (https://docs.airnowapi.org/faq) states the web services are free with no charge to use the data; access requires free registration for an API key. Terms of Service (https://docs.airnowapi.org/termsOfService) and Data Use Guidelines (https://docs.airnowapi.org/docs/DataUseGuidelines.pdf) cover attribution, logos, and accuracy caveats—no non-commercial-only restriction or commercial agreement requirement appears on those public pages. Entry’s commercial-use distinction is unsupported.
